current.text: He is projected to come off the bench. The projected Spurs bench is Champagnie, Harris, Kornet, Keldon Johnson and Bryant.
He is likely the 10th man in the rotation, ahead of Harrison Barnes. As the next young forward, he puts pressure on Barnes's minutes.
He should see more minutes as the long-term power forward next to Wembanyama.
He blocked 2 shots a game over two Summer League games.
The Spurs are very deep at forward. Minutes may stay low across the roster after the long playoff run.
The Spurs are expected to consolidate their forward depth through trades, though not right away.
The Spurs have only 13 back-to-backs. Their fantasy playoff schedule is 3-4-3 games for a March 28 end, which is okay but not great.
The Spurs are projected to win about 63 games and could take the top seed in the West.
